jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The IT Product Owner (m/f/d) for EPC Project Delivery owns the global portfolio of EPC IT applications that support the planning, control and execution of Exyte EPC projects. The role defines the product vision, roadmap and investment priorities, translates Project Delivery needs into scalable digital capabilities, and ensures products are adopted, reliable, integrated and commercially sustainable throughout their lifecycle. The role connects Project Delivery, Corporate IT and external partners to deliver measurable business value.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Define and manage the product vision, roadmap, priorities and investment portfolio for EPC Project Delivery.
- Translate common needs across Project Management, Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning into scalable product capabilities and measurable outcomes.
- Own portfolio lifecycle decisions, including investment, improvement, consolidation, replacement and retirement.
- Ensure products are successfully delivered, adopted, integrated, secure, reliable and supportable.
- Manage product budgets, service performance, licenses, risks, vendors and delivery partners.
- Lead the product team and establish effective governance across business stakeholders, Corporate IT and external partners.

Show your expertise

- 8+ years of experience managing digital products, enterprise applications, or technology-enabled business capabilities within EPC, engineering, construction, or comparable capital-project environments.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), experience with Primavera, SAP, RIB, SharePoint, or comparable platforms is an advantage.
- Strong expertise in product and application portfolio management, including strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, investment decisions, and lifecycle management.
- Solid understanding of EPC project delivery and construction business processes, including areas such as planning, project controls, cost management, construction, or information management.
- Good knowledge of solution architecture, systems integration, data management, cybersecurity, and IT service management.
- Commercially minded leader with experience managing budgets, software licensing, sourcing, vendor performance, and total cost of ownership.
- Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence international stakeholders, and drive technology-enabled transformation.
Fluency in English is required, German language skills are considered a strong advantage.
What we offer you
- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through eGym Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

What to Expect

The Employee Relations Partner conducts investigations into employee relations concerns and supports overall positive workforce engagement. This position is both hands-on and strategic and requires a high degree of collaboration to provide investigative and employee relations expertise. This is a full-time onsite position.We’ve posted this role in other locations to attract a diverse pool of candidates - but please note there is only one open position.We’ve posted this role in other locations to attract a diverse pool of candidates - but please note there is only one open position.

What You’ll Do

- Independently conduct unbiased investigations, determine findings, and prepare all required documentation. This includes but is not limited to preparing a clear and concise report summarizing findings of the investigation in accordance with applicable local laws, as well as maintaining case management/tracking tools
- Conduct in-person, web-based and phone-based witness interviews. Analyze information collected from witnesses and evidence and reach timely and well-reasoned conclusions.  This includes effectively assessing witness credibility and fostering effective communication with all individuals involved in the investigative process
- Maintain confidentiality and sensitivity to all issues

What You’ll Bring

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

Experts. Talents. Leaders.

jobs.description:
Akkodis is a global digital engineering consulting company that brings together technology and talent to accelerate transformation, drive innovation, and shape a smarter future. With more than 40,000 experts across over 30 countries, we connect industries and technologies - from AI and data analytics to cloud, edge computing, automation and cybersecurity.

Kundendetails

We are currently seeking a talented professional to join our team in Munich for an exciting project with one of our clients in the aerospace industry.

Stellenbeschreibung

- Monitor, control and evaluate environmental test campaigns
- Maintain thermal-vacuum chambers and associated test equipment
- Define test processes and environmental test facility configurations
- Support the specification of environmental test equipment in collaboration with engineering teams

Profil

- Knowledge of space standards, environmental test setups and spacecraft qualification testing

- Hands-on experience with metrology equipment such as CMMs and laser trackers

jobs.occupation: Information & Cyber Security Manager (m/f/d) at Allianz SE (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Allianz's strong inclusive culture encourages people to speak their minds, get involved and question the status quo. One means to cultivate teams with different perspectives is a regular rotation of Allianz Executive employees across functions, Allianz entities and geographies. Therefore, the company expects from its employees a general openness and a high motivation to regularly change positions and collect experiences across Allianz Group.
Who will you join?

The Allianz Group Information Security Function ensures that Information Security and Cyber Risks that may impact the successful delivery of Allianz business objectives are identified and properly addressed. It ensures that Allianz information is adequately protected, in line with legal and regulatory requirements. The Allianz Group Information Security Function maintains the Allianz Information Security strategy and related central investment program, oversees Global Identity and Access Management Governance and monitors and steers the Operating Entities globally across Allianz Group.

How can you make an impact?

Allianz is seeking for experienced and forward-thinking Information and Cyber Security Manager for the harmonization and alignment of cyber security investment budget and portfolio with projects conducted globally across Allianz Group and locally within Operating Entities. This role acts at the intersection of Group, Shared Services (Cyber Defence Center, Operational Information Security) and Operating Entities with understanding of cyber security, technology and financial services processes, it is responsible for ensuring that our digital environment is designed and built with security at their core, by design and by default.
As a key member of the Group Information Security team, you will drive strategic and tactical initiatives with focus on increasing detection within cyber-attacks, and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders to ensure that security is embedded throughout the entire lifecycle of digital environment.

What are you made of?

What will make you succeed in the position:

- Educational Background: Degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Business Information Systems, Economics or related field is required. Master degree required
- Professional certifications in Information Security (e.g. CRISC, CISM, CISA, CISSP), Process and Service Management (e.g. ITIL) as well as Project Management (e.g. PMI, PMP)
- Practical experience in threat and risk-based solution design: Strong ability to apply threat modeling, risk assessments, and secure design principles to ensure that digital environment is resilient, compliant to law and regulation, and aligned with organizational risk appetite
- Knowledge of current IT and (related) security technologies and controls (e.g. Cloud, AI, Software Development toolchains)

What qualifies for the position:

- Successful track record in working for large and diverse international organizations
- Communication and Influence: Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex security topics to both technical and non-technical audiences and drive secure-by-design mindset across teams
- Analytical and Decision-Making Skills: Strong analytical and conceptual thinking with the ability to assess technical risk, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend secure, practical solutions in complex environments
- Strategic Thinking and Technology Enablement: Proven track record in translating business objectives into secure technical architectures, enabling innovation while maintaining robust cyber resilience
- Cross-Functional Collaboration experience, working with business stakeholders, operational security, enterprise architecture and development teams to embed security into IT and business projects and solutions
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

* End-to-end management of recruiting activities across a broad range of functions and position levels, including both tariff and non-tariff roles, while ensuring an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience
* Close collaboration with HR, Works Councils, business leaders, and global stakeholders to provide guidance on recruiting processes, governance, labor relations, and talent acquisition strategies

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Extensive Talent Acquisition experience with a strong end-to-end recruiting generalist background, ideally gained within a global industrial or corporate environment
* Proven experience leading recruiting projects and successfully navigating complex matrix organizations with multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong project management skills and experience driving recruiting or organizational transformation initiatives.
* High data affinity with the ability to interpret recruiting metrics, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions using applicant tracking systems and recruiting analytics
* Sound understanding of collective bargaining agreements (tariff structures), experience collaborating with Works Councils, and familiarity with governance processes in a corporate environment
* Professional proficiency in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
